training.observations: desired joint angles 7, actual gripper width 1, red/green/blue xyz+sin(yaw)+cos(yaw) each5, total23
training.actions: delta desired joint angles7 + next observed gripper width1; latter is imitation target not original gripper command
training.normalizer: training episodes only; frozen for all evaluations
training.checkpoint_selection: Highest fixed ID development success; ties lower validation EMA loss (last 5000 steps mean), then earlier checkpoint
training.data: Original vision state PKLs from Zeus-Omni/D3IL-Vision mirror, 1094 hashes matched to its metadata; official ZIP blocked by quota, no independent official byte comparison

id_evaluation.source: new deterministic contexts from official manager Box ranges, seed20261107; NOT official released test contexts
id_evaluation.post_id: ID baseline only; no OOD or XY LiPo on joint actions
id_evaluation.timing: 4 concurrent GPU evaluations; not uncontended latency
id_evaluation.success_rule: all3 boxes at XY distance <=.06m from fixed goal and pairwise Z differences>.03m; no dwell-time requirement
id_evaluation.partial_metrics: historical goal-entry of1/2 distinct boxes; not stable stack levels
id_evaluation.controller: jointTrackingController; desired joint increments accumulated from reset actual joints; width>.075 opens else closes; fresh physical state read after step
id_evaluation.observation_difference_from_official_wra: sin/cos instead of tan yaw; actual gripper width instead of preceding predicted width for train/eval consistency

scope: state-based FM imitation learning; single training seed42; simulation ID only; original vision-data state mirror split and new simulator ID contexts, not official benchmark reproduction

early_stopping.loss_summary: mean EMA validation loss at last five 1000-step evaluations
early_stopping.improvement_rule: Either loss or success reaches improvement threshold against its retained improvement anchor; reset patience; cumulative small gains count
early_stopping.scheduler: Original 1m cosine schedule retained; no restart or schedule compression
early_stopping.dev_compute_timing: Not used for reported compute comparison due to parallel execution
early_stopping.trainer_pause: cooperative file gate after atomic checkpoint; same Adam/RNG resumes

evaluation_contexts.target: manager target sample is unused in official set_context; keep fixed simulator target
evaluation_contexts.overlap: all142 unique contexts, none matches any demo context rounded to6 decimals
evaluation_contexts.filtering: no policy-dependent exclusions or sample replacement
